_readme: Smart Channels gallery manifest.
This file is CONTENT, not source code. Adding, editing, reordering or
unpublishing a photograph is done here and nowhere else — no file under
src/ needs to change, and the grid, lightbox, filters and ordering all
adapt to whatever this file contains.
TO ADD A PHOTOGRAPH
1. Drop the original (any size, JPG or PNG) in source-assets/gallery/
2. npm run gallery:ingest
- converts it to WebP at several widths under public/images/gallery/
- measures it and appends a stub entry to the items array below
3. Fill in the stub: category, technology, captions in both languages,
alt text in both languages, and any of project / industry /
location / date that apply.
4. Set "published": true
Nothing appears on the site until published is true. A stub left half
filled is safe to commit.
ORDERING  sortOrder ascending, then date descending, then id.
FEATURED  featured: true promotes an item to the homepage preview.
The allowed values for category and technology are the unions in
src/types/content.ts; the ingest script and the build both reject
anything else rather than silently dropping it.
THE TWO ENTRIES BELOW ARE A WORKED EXAMPLE, NOT PUBLISHED CONTENT.
They show exactly what a complete entry looks like — every field filled,
captions and alt text in both languages. Both are published: false and
therefore render nowhere, because the provenance of the supplied
photographs has not been confirmed: some are Smart Channels' own delivery
work and some are stock or vendor imagery, and a caption on a gallery tile
is a factual claim about work delivered. Set published: true only for
photographs confirmed as Smart Channels' own.
pendingNote: Awaiting confirmation of which photographs are Smart Channels' own delivery work.
